content:
一个简单的[Fabric](https://fabricmc.net)模组，用于使加载界面变暗。

![游戏内效果](https://cdn-raw.modrinth.com/data/h3XWIuzM/images/b059b8c3ca7eca7d0747a9a12496f6634e4fb081.png)

更新日志可在[此处](https://github.com/A5b84/dark-loading-screen/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)查看。

## 颜色配置
若同时安装[Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)和[Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)，可在游戏内调整颜色设置。

### 手动配置
创建或编辑`.minecraft/config/dark-loading-screen.json`文件，默认配置如下：
```json
{
    "background": "14181c",
    "bar": "e22837",
    "barBackground": "14181c",
    "border": "303336",
    "logo": "ffffff",
    "fadeIn": 1.0,
    "fadeOut": 2.0
}
```

手动修改配置需重启游戏后生效。
